lines.text: There's a kind of tired that doesn't show up until the house goes quiet and everyone else is asleep.
That's usually when the question comes, quiet and honest: does anyone actually see what I'm carrying?
The phone stays dark. The reply doesn't come. The silence starts to sound like an answer.
But silence was never the same thing as absence.
He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
You don't have to perform your way back to strong. You just have to stay close enough to receive it.

bold: silence was never the same thing as absence
title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Not As Alone As It Feels
story: A weary figure sits alone under a single lamp at midnight while the house sleeps, then holds a phone glowing unanswered in a dark room, and finally rises into warm gold light with hands lifted - the question every tired heart asks, answered by Isaiah 40:29: He giveth power to the faint.
